Name: Universe of Chickens
Author: LunaVicious2
Description:
[b]Universe of Chickens[/b]
This mod added 13+ new chickens at first... but i kept adding more! So... If you [u]dont[/u] like bright colored chickens... or dont want a ridiculous amount of them in your game...chances are this mod wont be for you.
[i]However...[/i]
If you [b][u]are[/u][/b] someone who likes having more color on your farm, and [b]always[/b] wants [b]more[/b] chickens - then this mod is for you!

These chickens are intended to be a "mid-to late-game" addition, with the idea that these chickens will be way more profitable then the original, vanilla game chickens. Ideal for players who thrive on Ranching!

This is my first mod and I just want to say thank you for checking it out! If you like it, please endorse it <3
Everything you may wanna know about this mod is below, behind spoilers so you dont have to read anything that doesn't apply to you.

[b]Enjoy your Universe of Chickens![/b]

[b]Unlock Conditions[/b]
[spoiler] To Unlock the Chickens, you will need to have a 'Big Coop' Built. From there, you just have to take a trip to visit Marnie! Marnie will also send you a letter in case you forget - with a little hay to help you get started! [/spoiler]

[b]Compatibility[/b]
[spoiler]
Should be fully Compatible with everything, as in it shouldn't cause errors. These are new chickens, entries and products, so they do not override any animals.
If you find any issues, please include your [url=https://smapi.io/log/]SMAPI log[/url] and let me know in the comments/bug reports, what's going on.
Feel free to request compatibility with other mods as well if you feel its needed.

[i]Mobile/Android Note
[/i]It isn't giving me any errors on mobile, but i have not tested completely in mobile yet. Use with caution! [/spoiler]

[b]Configurations and Removal[/b]
[spoiler]You can disable any chicken that does not meet your expectations using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/games/stardewvalley]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url]. If you disable a chicken you already have in game, you will break it and any associated products. It is recommended to sell all chickens and products of the variant you want to disable [b][u]before[/u][/b] using GMCM to disable it. You can also choose if you want the objects to be included from Perfection. 

All chickens are true by default, and the objects are not required for perfection by default. 

This mod can be added or removed at any time as long as you sell/remove existing modded items first [b][u]before[/u][/b] removal.
[/spoiler]

[b]Recommended Mods[/b]
[spoiler]
Just some mods I recommend along side mine. 
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29997]Livestock Bazaar[/url] and its dependencies for a nice, visually appealing menu in Marnie's shop.
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7736]Auto Forager (previously AutoShaker)[/url] auto pick up eggs and other things! Built in compatibility.
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25586]Jen's Mega Coop and Barn[/url] you'll need more space for your new chickens!
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33727]Gigantic Coop and Barn[/url] if you think you'll need even [i]more[/i] space! [used in some of the mods images]
[/spoiler]
